name: Nkosiyam Building Contractors
headline: Built properly. Finished when we said.
intro: A family-run building team working across the Upper Highway. New builds, extensions, alterations, and the kind of finishing that still looks right in ten years.
heroImage: wide photograph of a partly built double storey brick house in a leafy South African suburb, scaffolding up, late afternoon sun, blue sky, professional architectural photography
servicesSub: From a single wall to a whole house, run by the same team from first day to handover.

services.title: New builds
services.detail: From foundation to handover, managed by one team who are on site every day.
services.image: photograph of a newly completed modern face brick family home in South Africa, neat paved driveway, clear sky, estate agent photography

services.title: Extensions and alterations
services.detail: An extra room, a second storey, or opening a kitchen up into the living room.
services.image: photograph of a bright open plan kitchen extension with large sliding doors onto a garden, South African home, natural daylight, interior photography

services.title: Renovations
services.detail: Bathrooms, kitchens, and putting right what somebody else left behind.
services.image: photograph of a freshly renovated modern bathroom with large format tiles and a glass shower, warm lighting, interior photography

services.title: Boundary walls and paving
services.detail: Walls, driveways and drainage that still works after a Durban storm.
services.image: photograph of a newly built plastered boundary wall and paved driveway at a suburban South African house, sunny day

reasons.title: One number to call
reasons.detail: You speak to the person running the site, not an office that will phone you back.

reasons.title: Quoted properly
reasons.detail: A written quote with the materials listed, so you can see what changed if anything changes.

reasons.title: We clean up
reasons.detail: The site is swept at the end of every day. It matters more than people admit.

name: APR Roofing Contractors
area: Pinetown, New Germany, Westville and surrounds
headline: A roof that holds, through a Durban summer.
intro: Roof repairs, replacements and waterproofing across the Pinetown area. If it is leaking, we will tell you honestly whether it needs fixing or replacing.
heroImage: wide photograph of a roofer in safety harness working on a tiled roof of a South African house, dramatic sky with building storm clouds, late afternoon light, professional photography
servicesSub: Most of what we do starts with a leak. Some of it stops the next one.

services.title: Leak repairs
services.detail: Found, fixed, and tested with a hose before we pack up and leave.
services.image: close up photograph of hands repairing a cracked roof tile with sealant, tools beside, bright daylight, documentary photography

services.title: Re-roofing
services.detail: Tile, IBR and corrugated, stripped back and replaced properly.
services.image: photograph of a new charcoal grey metal IBR roof on a South African house seen from above, clean lines, sunny day, aerial photography

services.title: Waterproofing
services.detail: Flat roofs, parapets, and the valleys where it always starts.
services.image: photograph of a worker applying waterproofing membrane with a roller to a flat concrete roof, bright sunlight, documentary photography

services.title: Gutters and downpipes
services.detail: Cleared, repaired or replaced before the rainy season arrives.
services.image: photograph of clean new white gutters and downpipe on the edge of a house roof against a blue sky

reasons.title: We climb up first
reasons.detail: No quote over the phone. We look at the roof, then tell you what it actually needs.

reasons.title: Honest about replacement
reasons.detail: A repair that will not last is not cheaper. If that is the answer, we will say so.

reasons.title: Insurance paperwork
reasons.detail: Photographs and a written report, ready for a storm damage claim.

name: P4 Plumbing
area: Durban, Berea, Glenwood and the Bluff
headline: Blocked, burst or leaking. Same day where we can.
intro: A Durban plumber for the jobs that cannot wait, and the ones that can. Geysers, drains, leaks and bathroom installations.
heroImage: wide photograph of a professional plumber in uniform working under a kitchen sink with a wrench, clean modern South African home, natural light, documentary photography
servicesSub: Most of it is urgent. All of it is quoted before we start.

services.title: Blocked drains
services.detail: Cleared with a machine, not a chemical that works for a week.
services.image: photograph of a plumber using a drain cleaning machine on an outdoor drain at a South African house, daylight, documentary photography

services.title: Geysers
services.detail: Repairs, replacements, and the compliance certificate afterwards.
services.image: photograph of a newly installed white electric geyser water heater in a roof space with neat copper pipework, work light

services.title: Burst pipes and leaks
services.detail: Traced, exposed and repaired, including under a slab.
services.image: close up photograph of a plumber repairing a copper water pipe joint with a wrench, water droplets, bright light

services.title: Bathroom installations
services.detail: New taps through to a full refit, plumbed to code.
services.image: photograph of a modern renovated bathroom with a freestanding basin and chrome taps, soft daylight, interior photography

reasons.title: We answer the phone
reasons.detail: A plumber you cannot get hold of is not a plumber.

reasons.title: Priced before we start
reasons.detail: You know the number before any work begins, not afterwards.

reasons.title: Certificates issued
reasons.detail: Plumbing compliance certificates for a sale or an insurance claim.
